source_authority.curation_source_note: Benchmarks are quality axes only; no asset, layout, palette, music, name or story copying is allowed.

project_promise.one_sentence: A compact 2D fighting game where every hit visibly changes tempo and space control.
project_promise.target_player_feeling: The player should feel precise, threatened and rewarded by clear reads.
project_promise.non_generic_identity: Martial discipline, grounded impacts and arena pressure define the game.
project_promise.first_10_seconds_test: The title, stance, first movement and first hit must communicate readable duel pressure.

benchmark_axis_matrix.inherited_quality: frame-readable risk and reward around spacing, startup and recovery.
benchmark_axis_matrix.project_specific_translation: Use small roster move kits with explicit startup, active, recovery and punish windows.
benchmark_axis_matrix.forbidden_copy_boundary: Do not copy roster, moves, stage layout, voices, names or frame data.
benchmark_axis_matrix.evidence_metric: moveset frame data validates and playtest confirms punishable recovery.

benchmark_axis_matrix.inherited_quality: memorable groove and punchy SFX that sell physical impact.
benchmark_axis_matrix.project_specific_translation: Reserve SFX priority for hits and use a compact XGM2 groove with clear low-end rhythm.
benchmark_axis_matrix.forbidden_copy_boundary: Do not copy melodies, samples, arrangement, voice clips or instrument patches.
benchmark_axis_matrix.evidence_metric: audio validation plus SFX priority report shows hits remain readable.

benchmark_axis_matrix.inherited_quality: high-energy sprite presence and readable chaos.
benchmark_axis_matrix.project_specific_translation: Use bold silhouettes, constrained hit sparks and arena parallax that never hides hurtboxes.
benchmark_axis_matrix.forbidden_copy_boundary: Do not copy characters, bosses, palettes, props or stage composition.
benchmark_axis_matrix.evidence_metric: visual delivery gate confirms sprite wins over FX in 320x224.

benchmark_axis_matrix.inherited_quality: environment guides the player without explicit instruction.
benchmark_axis_matrix.project_specific_translation: Teach pressure and corner escape through arena landmarks before harder opponents.
benchmark_axis_matrix.forbidden_copy_boundary: Do not copy map, biomes, enemies, doors or progression structure.
benchmark_axis_matrix.evidence_metric: level_design_report confirms golden path and pressure rhythm.

benchmark_axis_matrix.inherited_quality: hardware tricks serve mood and setpiece identity.
benchmark_axis_matrix.project_specific_translation: Use one signed raster or palette effect only when it improves duel readability or arena drama.
benchmark_axis_matrix.forbidden_copy_boundary: Do not copy specific setpieces, stages, monsters or timing tricks as spectacle for its own sake.
benchmark_axis_matrix.evidence_metric: technique usage manifest, VDP budget report and BlastEm capture prove the effect.

signature_pillars.player_visible_payoff: The player can understand why a hit landed and what recovery allowed it.
Major hits sound bigger without masking music or next input feedback.
The arena reinforces momentum without swallowing the fighters.

proactive_gap_radar.current_symptom: Project has no declared title/logo behavior.
proactive_gap_radar.why_it_limits_the_game: The game can look technically competent but still feel like a lab build.
proactive_gap_radar.proposed_director_move: Create brand_identity_manifest with silhouette, thumbnail and runtime layer plan.
proactive_gap_radar.acceptance_evidence: brand identity schema validates and title screen passes BlastEm gate.

proactive_gap_radar.current_symptom: Hit response is not yet a named signature moment.
proactive_gap_radar.why_it_limits_the_game: Combat may be functional but forgettable.
proactive_gap_radar.proposed_director_move: Define impact frame, hitstop, SFX priority and recoil recovery as a core signature.
proactive_gap_radar.acceptance_evidence: motion and audio gates verify impact in BlastEm.

proactive_gap_radar.current_symptom: Arena depth has no authored role.
proactive_gap_radar.why_it_limits_the_game: The stage may read as a backdrop instead of a fighting space.
proactive_gap_radar.proposed_director_move: Declare parallax or palette-cycle role tied to pressure state.
proactive_gap_radar.acceptance_evidence: scene direction and budget reports show readable arena pressure.

proactive_gap_radar.current_symptom: Music has no declared memorable hook or SFX protection plan.
proactive_gap_radar.why_it_limits_the_game: The game may feel silent, generic or masked during combat.
proactive_gap_radar.proposed_director_move: Define core loop scope, SFX priority and optional phase cue.
proactive_gap_radar.acceptance_evidence: composition scope and audio validation pass.

proactive_gap_radar.current_symptom: The first ten seconds do not yet prove genre, tone and quality.
proactive_gap_radar.why_it_limits_the_game: The player may not understand why the project is special before gameplay begins.
proactive_gap_radar.proposed_director_move: Script title idle, press-start feedback and first playable beat as one promise.
proactive_gap_radar.acceptance_evidence: title/front-end and first playable scene pass closeout.

signature_scene_candidates.signature_moment: A clean counter hit freezes the opponent, pulses the arena light and shifts music pressure.
signature_scene_candidates.gameplay_payoff: The player understands spacing, punish and momentum.
signature_scene_candidates.visual_payoff: Fighter silhouette remains dominant while arena reacts subtly.
signature_scene_candidates.audio_payoff: Hit SFX cuts through the groove without masking recovery.
signature_scene_candidates.technical_showcase: Controlled hitstop, palette pulse and XGM2 SFX priority.
signature_scene_candidates.fallback: Keep hitstop and SFX priority if palette pulse exceeds budget.
